name: Pullman Pattaya Hotel G
short_description: A 13-storey, 353-room hotel on a private stretch of Wong Amat Beach in northern Pattaya, with the city's only beach club and two outdoor pools.
ai_summary: Pullman Pattaya Hotel G occupies a 13-storey tower on a private stretch of Wong Amat Beach in northern Pattaya, blending a zen-inspired lobby of greenery and wooden floors with 353 rooms across the main building and Pool Wing. The property houses Pattaya's only beach club, with seaside dining, two outdoor pools, Aisawan Spa, and a kids' club, and buffet breakfast is included in all rates. Guests consistently praise the stunning beachfront views and first-class pool and beach access, with friendly staff and modern amenities cited throughout, though a subset of rooms are noted as showing some age despite recent renovations.

faqs.question: Does Pullman Pattaya Hotel G have a beach club?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's home to Pattaya's only beach club, offering seaside-style dining on a private stretch of Wong Amat Beach, alongside two outdoor pools and a full-service spa.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included at Pullman Pattaya Hotel G?
faqs.answer: Yes -- buffet breakfast is included in all room rates, and guests consistently praise the beachfront setting and pool access as standout features of the stay.
